pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid near Brussels-Midi station, with whole private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and social spaces.

Family and budget stay

Choose a whole private room and confirm its beds, occupancy and cot requirements. A dorm bed is a different booking product. The operator lists a communal guest kitchen and lounge, useful for a family willing to share facilities.

The Rue Bara hotel is convenient for Brussels-Midi rail connections. Allow walking or transit time to central sights and plan your arrival route. Compare total private-room cost, breakfast, taxes, parking and luggage-storage charges for your dates.

Guest feedback

The operator publishes TrustYou feedback from verified stays. Family guests describe useful kitchen access and comfortable rooms, while others object to luggage-storage and early-check-in charges or report service and housekeeping problems. These are guest accounts rather than independent inspection findings. The published Location component is 4.4/5; unsupported component scores remain unscored.

Opening and scale

MEININGER records the Bruxelles Gare du Midi opening milestone on 6 August 2019 in its later Lyon release. The September 3 publication date on a syndicated opening article is separate.

The original hotel announcement reports 150 rooms, 678 beds and 6,700 square metres of above-ground gross floor area. These opening figures are not taken from the earlier planned 668-bed proposal. No hotel-specific construction budget was verified.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: operator page TrustYou snapshot 2,299 verified-stay reviews, overall 4.3/5, Location 4.4/5 rounded to 4.5. WiFi/Vibe are not hotel rubric axes. Rooms, Service, Cleanliness and Value sub-scores not published in opened snapshot, left null rather than inferred from prose or overall. Review excerpts read from the operator page’s public family-review endpoint; operator-collected feedback, not an independent critic. MICHELIN complete Brussels-and-surroundings list 1–39 of 39 has no MEININGER; Forbes Brussels directory has no match. AAA awards exclude Belgium. Acclaim 0 records checked-guide absence.

pin.longFormSummary:
A castle-themed family hotel beside LEGOLAND California, with wizard, knight and princess rooms, separate children’s sleeping areas and LEGO treasure hunts.

Family stay

Choose the exact Knights & Dragons, Royal Princess or Magic Wizard room category and confirm beds, occupancy and any cot needs. The hotel advertises interactive play, treasure hunts, entertainment and an outdoor pool; check the current activity and pool schedule.

Both onsite hotels sell room-only stays, so park admission is not included in every booking. Compare your selected package for tickets, breakfast, parking, taxes and cancellation terms. An expired per-person hotel-and-ticket promotion is not a current whole-room quote.

Review tradeoffs

Family guests praise the themed bedrooms, treasure chests and short walk to the park. Other guests report check-in delays, noise, food quality problems and high extra charges. The Tripadvisor component scores describe a research snapshot, not live ratings. Compare the full holiday cost before booking.

Opening and capacity

The operator’s grand-opening announcement, reproduced by The Brick Show, dates the California Castle Hotel opening to 27 April 2018. It is the resort’s second onsite hotel and is distinct from the original LEGOLAND Hotel.

The current official hotel FAQ reports 250 themed rooms. No hotel-specific construction investment was verified; costs for Castle Hotels in other countries are not substituted.
